things i've built.

a few projects, experiments, and rabbit holes.

  1. WorldFork↗

    apr 2026

    A multi-agent simulation engine that forks scenarios into branching futures using Monte Carlo tree search.

    1st place, HackTech @ Caltech · ICML 2026 workshops

  2. Prediction Agent

    jun 2026

    A self-improving agent that turns research into probability forecasts through tool use, reasoning, and iterative refinement.

    overall winner, Prophet Hacks · ICML Forecasting Workshop oral

  3. R-EYE-DER↗

    jan 2026

    An AR driver coaching system using real-time gaze tracking and object detection to help build better visual scanning habits.

    winner, Raven AR track · MIT Reality Hacks

  4. HarrowMe

    2023–24

    A school app for attendance and prefect sanctions. Built with a team of six, used by 2,000 people a month at its peak.

    Flutter · Firebase
